notes.subject: bel
notes.rationale: נפש is throat/breath/life-force, rendered as 'bel' (seat of feeling), not a separate 'soul'.

notes.subject: תפלה
notes.rationale: 'Frivolity/folly': God does not set it — readings split between 'God regards not the folly (of the oppressors)' and 'God charges no wrongdoing' or 'does not answer the empty prayer'.

notes.subject: ינאקו / תשוע
notes.rationale: Groan vs cry out — escalating parallel cry of victims answered only by divine silence.

translation: Long taun ol manmeri i krai bilong pen, na bel bilong ol man ol i bagarapim i singaut; tasol Eloa i no putim ⟨i⟩ tok nating.

tokens.gloss: bilong ol man ol i bagarapim
